Per-subject run coverage (file names, T0014 re-walk): interictal runs in 56/57 subjects (55 subjects x 2 runs + 1 subject x 1 run = 111); sub-HUP158 has NO interictal run (its only recording is task-ictal_acq-seeg_run-04). Ictal runs in 56/57 subjects (1-5 runs each: 5 runs n=24, 3 n=16, 4 n=6, 2 n=6, 1 n=4); sub-HUP165 has NO ictal run (2 interictal runs only). 55/57 subjects have both ictal and interictal runs.
verified_modalities.electrode_localisation: verified_present as files: one *_space-fsaverage_electrodes.tsv + coordsystem.json per subject (57/57), all 57 with numeric x,y,z for contacts. Frame/unit conflict -> to_verify (see coordinate_frame_conflict).

coordinate_frame_conflict.readme: README: 'electrode localizations in ICBM152 MNI space'
coordinate_frame_conflict.magnitude_check: per-subject max |coordinate| ranges 40.7-103.2 across the 57 electrodes.tsv files, i.e. millimetre-scale values, inconsistent with the declared unit 'm'
coordinate_frame_conflict.action: R2 must decide frame (fsaverage surface RAS vs ICBM152/MNI volume) and unit (mm vs m) before any geometry artifact; do not treat as verified MNI-mm

verified_modalities.anatomical_mri_ct_dwi: reported_absent in the v1.1.3 file tree: only ieeg/ datatype directories; no anat/, dwi/, CT, sourcedata/ or derivatives/. Patient-specific structural connectome cannot be built -> a template/normative connectome (e.g. atlas-based) would be required for TVB-style modeling
verified_modalities.seizure_annotations: verified_present: events.tsv for all 208 ictal runs (none for interictal runs); channels.tsv status_description carries clinician 'soz' tags in 57/57 subjects (checked first channels.tsv per subject)

intervention_linkage.status: verified_present (contact level) for 57/57 subjects in v1.1.3
intervention_linkage.basis: channels.tsv status_description contains 'resect' tags in 57/57 subjects (first channels.tsv per subject inspected); README: channels overlapping the resection/ablation zone 'rigorously determined by segmenting the resection cavity'
intervention_linkage.intervention_classes: README: each patient underwent 'surgical resection or laser ablation'. participants.json defines a 'therapy' column with levels ABLATION / RESECTION / RNS; per-subject therapy values are in participants.tsv, which is sealed and was not opened -> per-subject resection-vs-ablation split not_accessible here (vault/R2 only). The 'resect' tag denotes resection OR ablation zone, not distinguished in channels.tsv
intervention_linkage.stimulation_settings: README-reported only, not verified: the v1.1.3 README describes subsequent treatment by 'surgical resection or laser ablation' and mentions no stimulation; no stimulation/device-setting fields appear in any inspected sidecar. However participants.json (column-definition sidecar, sha256 6570fc4e..., re-fetched in T0014) defines a 'therapy' column with levels ABLATION / RESECTION / RNS ('responsive neurostimulation'), and 'outcome' level NR = 'no resection/surgery'. Whether any subject has therapy=RNS cannot be verified without participants.tsv, which is sealed under the outcome-sealing rule and was not opened -> to_verify (R2). Even if RNS subjects exist, no RNS settings, lead locations or stimulation logs are present in the v1.1.3 file tree.
intervention_linkage.rns_therapy_level_status: to_verify (R2, sealed participants.tsv): schema defines RNS level; per-subject presence not verifiable here

outcome_fields_present: Per participants.json (data dictionary only): 'outcome' (S successful/seizure freedom, F failed, NR no resection/surgery) and 'engel' (1-4). Values live in participants.tsv, SEALED for this study; no outcome counts or splits are reported in this card. CHANGES 1.1.1/1.1.2 state the participants/Engel fields were updated, so outcome labels are release-specific (v1.1.3).
follow_up_definition: not_reported in v1.1.3 metadata (participants.json defines no follow-up duration column); Kini 2019 (subset, A0034) reports outcome measured at >=1 year after surgery -> per-patient follow-up to_verify
eligibility: Best fit among open candidates: iEEG (ictal+interictal) + per-contact coordinates + contact-level resection/ablation-zone tags + clinician SOZ tags + Engel outcome field (sealed). Caveats: (a) coordinate frame/unit conflict to_verify; (b) no MRI/CT/DWI -> template connectome needed; (c) no per-patient follow-up duration; (d) incomplete per-subject run coverage: sub-HUP165 has no ictal run and sub-HUP158 has no interictal run (55/57 have both); (e) no stimulation intervention is README-reported only - participants.json defines an RNS therapy level, so the presence of RNS-treated subjects is to_verify (R2, sealed participants.tsv); no stimulation settings in any case; (f) README subject count (58) is stale relative to the release (57).
cohort_overlap: fam-hup-penn: Kini 2019 / EpiVR cohort is a subset (A0034; HUP080 named in Kini 2019 is in v1.1.3); Omni-iEEG 'hup' subset re-packages this dataset (A0040) - do not count as independent.

All other figures unchanged and re-verified from file names (57 subj, 319 EDF = 208 ictal / 111 interictal, 37 SEEG / 20 ECoG, 208 events.tsv all ictal). A0064 itself superseded A0033.
